fences.title: Bunny is the healthy-path portrait accelerator
fences.decision: Healthy browser tabs load content-addressed portrait bytes directly from Bunny; one failed real-image probe selects the canonical first-party fallback for that tab.
fences.reason: Direct Bunny delivery avoids charging every healthy portrait read to the Cloudflare Worker budget. A resolver failure on one network is the reason the fallback exists, not evidence that Bunny should be disabled globally.
fences.change_control: Retiring or replacing Bunny requires an explicit architecture migration that updates this registry, the delivery runbook, source policy, production and staging configuration, behavioral tests, and deploy guard in one reviewed change.

fences.title: Gene discovery is eligibility-gated and range-stable
fences.decision: Complete canonical profiles are indexable through one published-catalog predicate, while aliases redirect, incomplete profiles remain noindex, unknown symbols return 404, and the crawlable archive uses frozen self-locating prefix ranges rather than numeric pages. Homepage discovery reuses the existing non-visual description instead of adding visible archive controls; accessibility skip links are clipped until focused. Decorative printed selector alternatives are CSS-rendered ink rather than peer DOM facts, while their noninteractive fields name the resolved molecular value and mapped character result.
fences.reason: Agents need explicit card mappings and a link path they can choose from a known symbol, but that crawler frontier must not become perfunctory chrome that breaks the human card-gallery immersion. Frozen ranges provide the path without guessing, while the shared eligibility gate prevents arbitrary application shells or incomplete cards from becoming an unbounded search corpus.
fences.change_control: Gene response headers, HTML metadata, homepage discovery placement, archive membership, sitemap membership, llms.txt, renderer semantics, tests, instructions, and runbook must change atomically. Range boundaries may change only through an explicit biological-inventory migration; routine catalog publications must never rebalance them. Do not add the archive to the immersive Archive/Clans switcher, expose feed skip links at rest, or represent decorative selector ink as interactive controls or peer facts.

fences.title: Queue wakeups follow durable due times
fences.decision: Cloudflare Queue messages wake durable ledger work only when it is runnable; unfinished future work is delayed until the earliest next_attempt_at and is never polled by immediate replacement messages.
fences.reason: A single future retry otherwise creates an ack/read/delete/send feedback loop that consumes the daily Queue allowance without doing work. Short polling caps also spend retry attempts and can dead-letter a message before its durable backoff expires.
fences.change_control: Queue topology, durable status accounting, retry delays, consumer configuration, behavioral tests, instructions, and the runbook must change atomically. Any replacement must prove a bounded number of billable operations while no work is due.

fences.title: The primary Iconoplasm D1 is bounded operational state
fences.decision: The primary D1 stays below an 80% target of its 500,000,000-byte per-database wall by storing immutable profile prose once and moving publish events older than 30 days to a separately bound cold audit D1 after row-level verification.
fences.reason: Duplicated manifestation prose and an unbounded 297,818-row publish ledger filled the database and stopped all writes. The old dashboard compared the database to the unrelated 5 GB account allowance, so it reported roughly 10% usage at the per-database hard limit.
fences.change_control: Large payload placement, read-model columns, append-only ledgers, retention, archive bindings, capacity thresholds, observability, migrations, tests, instructions, runbook, and deploy enforcement must change atomically. Cold history may be removed from the hot database only after verified archival.
